decisions.decision: The demo tells the truth about three boundaries on slide one
decisions.rationale: The engine is proven but has no production caller (Phase 14 owns end-to-end); the Schedule D branch refuses by design (Phase 12); and guest bodies run with host privileges — effect-whitelist refusal and the pre-execution specifier gate are real, guest-body isolation is not. Step 7 was sketched as 'watch it refuse network access', checked before the spec was written, and the codebase turned out to be honest about not having it. Telling a finance audience what is not yet defended buys more credibility than a claim they can poke a hole in.

decisions.decision: The spec lives in demo/todo/, not docs/superpowers/specs/
decisions.rationale: AGENTS.md puts specs in a todo/ next to the code they concern and warns that a second planning location drifts from the one people edit. It is also the first file in demo/, which is the prescribed order: write the spec there before implementing.

decisions.decision: Source links pin a commit SHA, never a branch name
decisions.rationale: GitHub serves commit-pinned blobs permanently whether or not the branch is merged; a branch-name link rots on the next push.

context_notes: Phase 10 found fourteen plan defects and NOT ONE was a wrong tax number — research, planning, two review rounds and six executors independently reproduced every figure without correction. Every defect was in the machinery that proves the arithmetic: mutations that could not compile because removing an expression orphaned its binding, mutations a neighbouring operation absorbed, mutations mandated at gates whose leaves did not exist yet, acceptance tallies that excluded the very mutation closing a blocker, and a type guard that only worked against fresh object literals. Verification machinery fails silently and in the direction of looking successful. Four AGENTS.md sections came out of this, including a FOURTH instance of the signature defect: a proof iterating Object.keys() of the code under test, which could never notice an entry being deleted. The sharpest single artifact: swapping the line-16 dispatcher's condition order returns IDENTICAL cents on every ordinary return — only the method tag catches it, so a suite of realistic test returns would have shipped it fully green.
